newsitem.title: USA: Carbide/Graphite subpoenaed in price fixing case.
newsitem.headline: Carbide/Graphite subpoenaed in price fixing case.

text.p: Carbide/Graphite Group Inc said Thursday it has been served with a subpoena issued by a grand jury investigating price fixing by producers of graphite products in the United States and abroad during the past five years.
The company said the grand jury empanelled by the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania.
Carbide/Graphite said it is cooperating with the government in the investigation.

It also said the Antitrust Division of the United States Department of Justice has granted the company and certain former and present senior executives the opportunity to participate in its Corporate Leniency Program.

In exchange for cooperation, Carbide/Graphite explained, neither the company nor its executives who cooperate would be prosecuted criminally if charges are issued by the grand jury. The company and such executives have informed the government that they will avail themselves of this opportunity.
At this time, as far as Carbide/Graphite is aware, the government has not made a finding that any person or company violated the law. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
